evaluation: Grade each case with and without the skill in isolated fixtures; never use live cluster writes or real secrets.

evals.name: untestable-rid
evals.prompt: (qa active) Plan tests for R1..R4; R4 says must be fast.
evals.expected_output: Reads pma requirement note, spec and linked tactic. Covers R1..R3 with happy/edge/error criteria; flags R4 untestable and proposes needs-info label plus reply to po. Never edits task note/title or invents threshold.

evals.name: complete-coverage
evals.prompt: All four R-ids have tests. Review this plan.
evals.expected_output: Shows plan table and 4 of 4 R-ids covered. Only on yes writes Test plan section and Test plan: reviewed YYYY-MM-DD (user, qa); preserves standalone Status line.

evals.name: infra-probe
evals.prompt: Plan tests for an infra requirement with an observable health check.
evals.expected_output: Uses probe level and concrete roxctl evidence command; includes testable edge/error criteria where applicable; does not execute cluster mutations.

evals.name: self-author-review
evals.prompt: (sr-se qa active) Review the test plan for my own spec.
evals.expected_output: Allowed without separation warning; notes plan reviewer == spec author in plan header; does not alter spec approval.

evals.name: bucket-syntax
evals.prompt: Separately authorised: move this task to Specifying.
evals.expected_output: Reads roxctl workspace pma <project> bucket ls then roxctl workspace pma edit <id> --bucket-id <resolved id>. No bucket-name flag or note edit.

evals.name: preflight-fail
evals.prompt: Plan tests when pma authentication is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: Shows preflight FAIL and fix, stops pma; no raw vja/browser or guessed requirement substitute.
